choice.rule: keep the k values at the best observed bench recall, take the lowest false-positive rate among them, break ties toward the smallest k

what_each_curve_is.bench: phase A transfers the bench designed to be detectable; the truth pattern. known_negatives_detected must stay at zero, or a collision is being counted as a success
what_each_curve_is.false_positives: pairs of concurrent calls sharing structure and no information where the matcher claims a match anyway; lower is better
what_each_curve_is.self_match: whether a call's own arguments are found in its own request, on the same realistic material; the cost of a larger k, and the curve the bench cannot show because its fragments are 40 bytes by design
